faq.title: Have a Question?
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about the platform and courses

faq-1.question: How can I enroll in a course?
faq-1.answer: After creating an account on the platform, you can browse the available courses and click the "Subscribe" button for the course you want, then follow the payment steps if applicable.

faq-2.question: Are the courses recorded or live?
faq-2.answer: We offer a mix of recorded courses you can watch anytime, and live courses held according to a set schedule.

faq-3.question: Do I get a certificate after completing the course?
faq-3.answer: Yes, after completing all course requirements and passing the assessments, you'll receive a certified completion certificate that can be downloaded and shared.

faq-4.question: What payment methods are available?
faq-4.answer: We accept payment via credit cards (Visa/Mastercard), PayPal, and local bank transfer.

faq-5.question: Can I get a refund?
faq-5.answer: Yes, we offer a refund policy within the first 10 days of enrollment if you're not satisfied with the content.
